{{Quote|Master Chewbacca doesn't see how that information is of any use. Unless we know where he intended to go&mdash;''"<br />"''My money's on the Jawa Raceway.|C-3PO and Sligh, in a discussion regarding the whereabouts of Han Solo|<ref name="Ghost" />}}
The '''Jawa Raceway''' was a deep-[[Desert/Legends|desert]] location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|143|Jawa Raceway}}</ref> After [[Jula Darklighter|Jula]] and [[Silya Darklighter]]'s [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] was boarded by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] as it carried [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] [[Sligh]], [[Grees]], and [[Emala]] across Tatooine from the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] in search of the missing [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the group of travelers found that the [[vidmap]] previously placed on Solo's [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] was removed, leading to Sligh to speculate that their missing friend had gone to the Jawa Raceway. Silya Darklighter then said that they were situated north of the Raceway, and the group decided to search for Han Solo at the [[Bantha Burrows]] after the locations [[Sarlacc Gardens]] and [[Monk's Well]] were proposed as well.<ref name="Ghost" />
